_comment: Times are in simulation seconds. globalCooldown is a short pause after any action starts (all actions share it), against double presses. castTime makes an action a job in its cell: it takes that long there, shown on the cell, and the cell is busy meanwhile, but you can act elsewhere. cooldown (optional, per action) is extra time before that action can be used again. A job pays when it starts; if it fails it's refunded in full, and if the player cancels it they get cancelRefund of it back (0 to 1). Every action works on the selected grid cell (feeding the host is the outside panel's dial, not an action). Requirement: check = matter | placed | stat | unlocked | epoch | host (host mass in tonnes), filtered by item or category, condition = gt | gte | lt | lte | eq. revealRequirements unlock an action for good once met (tech tree), retireRequirements retire it for good, and requirements are checked every time. 'places' makes a seeding action: it creates that overdensity in the selected cell or deepens the one there. Any other action with a lootTable rolls it into the selected cell.

actions.name: perturb
actions.label: Perturb
actions.tooltip: Stretch a quantum fluctuation across the selected cell. It seeds a ripple (an overdensity) there, or deepens the one already there. The energy comes out of the host black hole.

actions.name: craft
actions.label: Build
actions.tooltip: Build the chosen recipe in the selected cell, paying with matter from cells within reach of it.

actions.name: use
actions.label: Open
actions.tooltip: Collapse the cache in the selected cell, or in the irradiator there. Its contents land in that cell.

actions.name: dismantle
actions.label: Dismantle
actions.tooltip: Take apart what's in the selected cell and return what it cost to the cell. An irradiator comes apart a layer at a time: its source, then its cache, then the irradiator.
